name: HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness
summary: HealthCo Healthcare & Wellness REIT (HCW) is a Real Estate Investment Trust listed on the ASX focused on owning healthcare and wellness property assets. The REIT’s objective is to provide exposure to a diversified portfolio underpinned by healthcare sector megatrends, targeting stable and growing distributions, long-term capital growth and positive environmental and social impact. HCW is Australia’s leading diversified healthcare REIT with a combined portfolio size of 1.4 billion US dollars. HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness REIT was incorporated on July 30th, 2021 in Australia.
